thread.title_full: Children's Advocacy Center announces first satellite location, expands services - NewsBreak

author: Zach Callan
title: Children's Advocacy Center announces first satellite location, expands services - NewsBreak
text:
By Zach Callan ,
8 hours ago
SAN ANGELO, Texas ( Concho Valley Homepage ) — The Children's Advocacy Center of Greater West Texas in San Angelo has announced the opening of its first satellite location in the history of the organization, which will be located in Brownwood, Texas.
In a press release, CACGWTX board of directors said, "the expansion comes at a time when services are needed in underserved counties."
Brown County previously had a Children's Advocacy Center in Early, Texas, but the center closed in 2021.
CACGWTX worked with local, regional and state partners to obtain offering services in Brownwood and purchased a location in southeast Brownwood, where operations began Tuesday, Sept. 1.
Art auction supports free tutoring for foster youth "CACGWTX is an umbrella agency with multiple programs and one of their programs is the
Children’s Advocacy Center (CAC) model of child advocacy services of forensic interviews,
family advocacy and resources, and mental health services," CACGWTX said. "These services will be offered in Brown and Coleman counties, providing more immediate resources to professionals of the Multe-Disciplinary Team (MDT.) Additionally, the CAC model serves as a coordinator of the MDT professionals made up of Law Enforcement Agencies, Department of Family and Protective Services (Child Investigations and Services), District Attorney Offices, Medical Providers, and Mental Health providers. This team works to advocate for the best interest of the child, with CACGWTX offering services which support the investigation of child abuse and services for the child and their families."
In a press release, Justin DeLoach, chief executive officer of CACGWTX, spoke about the new location.
"Our goal is to ensure children are given the opportunity to tell their story and be supported
throughout the investigative process and beyond," Justin DeLoach, chief executive officer of CACGWTX, said. "We’ve directly served the Concho Valley for 35 years providing a place
of hope and healing and we are excited to bring these much-needed services to the children of
Brown and Coleman County and work collaboratively with our MDT partners to support child
abuse victims and their families."
CACGWTX's main campus is located in San Angelo and has been operating in Tom Green County and the Concho Valley for 35 years, serving children and families who have been affected by child abuse.
